segments.title: November
segments.text: Hello Bandra! November is Black Friday, plus Thank U, Next. This month starts with gratitude and ends with the best long-plan prices of the year. First we say thank you. Then we say, sincerely, have you seen this annual?

segments.title: ₹13.6L
segments.text: So, the number. Our November target for Bandra is 13.6 lakh rupees. That's 3 per cent above last November. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 6.94 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 3.67 lakh, comebacks 2.45 lakh, and everything else 54,400. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 44 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 392 leads, 204 trials, and 44 buyers, with about 22 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.
Here's where the offers come in. Three offers carry 8.6 lakh rupees, which is 63 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Thank U, Next (Year)
segments.text: First up, Thank U, Next Year. Appreciation week. A guest pass to share, a members-only night, and a gift for anyone who's hit a hundred classes. No catch. Just gratitude, and glutes. The plan is 5 buyers at about 17,200, so 86,000 rupees.

segments.title: Secret Santa Squats
segments.text: Next, for gifting, Secret Santa Squats. Two classes and grip socks, sized for a Secret Santa budget. If the recipient loves it, half comes off their first month. The plan is 12 buyers at about 2,000, so 24,000 rupees.

segments.title: Black Friday, Strong Monday, Sore Tuesday
segments.text: And finally, the big one, Black Friday, Strong Monday, Sore Tuesday. Four days of the year's best long-plan prices, plus the last Club Nine seats. No one-month discounts. We're not that kind of studio. The plan is 10 buyers at about 75,000, so 7.5 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, appreciation week, with guest passes and hundred-class gifts. Week two, Secret Santa vouchers reach every office and group chat. Week three, members get the Black Friday dates first. Week four, four days of Black Friday, long plans only.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's November at Bandra. 13.6 lakh rupees, three offers, and 44 buyers to welcome. Grateful, gorgeous, and fully booked. That's November.
